goal: Test whether humanized variants RETAIN antigen binding and stability vs the parental.

expression.format: Fab or full IgG (mammalian, e.g. ExpiCHO/HEK293) for binding/DSF; scFv/Fab in E. coli periplasm acceptable for early ELISA triage
expression.note: express each variant + BOTH controls under identical conditions

assays.name: ELISA
assays.readout: OD450 titration vs antigen-coated plate; EC50 estimate

assays.name: SPR or BLI
assays.readout: kinetics vs immobilized antigen; compare K_D to the parental

assays.name: DSF (thermal shift)
assays.readout: SYPRO-Orange Tm; compare Tm to the parental (humanization often lowers Tm)

decision: KEEP variants that retain binding (K_D within an agreed fold of parental) AND keep Tm within an agreed margin; these balance humanness and developability.

controls.positive_parental: the PARENTAL non-human antibody — defines retained-binding (best K_D) and the stability ceiling (Tm); every humanized variant is judged against it
controls.negative_over_humanized_decoy: the OVER-HUMANIZED DECOY (humanized including the Vernier zone, no rescue) — expected to LOSE binding and/or Tm; proves the assay detects over-humanization
controls.negative_isotype: an irrelevant isotype-matched antibody — no specific antigen binding

expectation: Humanization commonly costs some affinity/stability; Vernier back-mutated and resurfaced variants should recover more than the over-humanized decoy.
